title: Hoiden
summary: HOI'DEN, noun A rude, bold girl; a romp. 1. A rude, bold man. [Not used in the United States.] HOI'DEN, adjective Rude; bold; inelegant; rustic. HOI'DEN, verb intransitive To romp rudely or indecently
